design.rationale: Clear separation: risk.mjs (scoring) vs view.mjs (render). Single responsibility, pure functions, deterministic given (tickets, today).

infrastructure.rationale: Zero-dependency client-side ES modules; no server, no build step. Runs in browser via index.html and under node --test.

security.rationale: No network, no eval, no secrets, no user-supplied template interpolation beyond seeded data. Renders bounded DOM strings; no injection surface.

ux_ui.rationale: Decision-ready summary cards (total/blocked/SLA-near/aging) plus risk-ordered rows with owner load; the support lead's core question answered at a glance.

performance.rationale: Synchronous O(n log n) sort over a small seeded ticket set; negligible cost, no async or I/O.

features.rationale: riskLabel, sortByRisk, summarizeTickets, renderSummaryCards, renderRiskRows — the full risk-triage surface, each test-covered.

data_architecture.rationale: Plain ticket records (id/owner/priority/status/ageHours/slaDueAt) with derived risk score + label; no persistence layer needed for a read-only dashboard.

devex.rationale: Single test command (node --test tests/*.test.mjs) re-runs the whole suite; 6/6 green, observed exit 0. No toolchain to install.

layer_walk.notes: Domain logic: risk scoring + sort + summarize.
Presentation: summary cards + risk rows render.
App wiring loads data and renders.
Real runner output: tests 6 / pass 6 / fail 0.
Declared logic + component layers, both re-runnable.
Five-stage SDLC run proof with executed pipeline_probe.
Adversarial: empty list / missing fields handled by defaults.
Retro + lessons recorded; executors re-ran real tests.

intent_vs_impl.intent_quote: spot aging, blocked, and SLA-near tickets from seeded data

known_gaps.gap: No automated e2e/browser layer — UI is exercised at the component layer via DOM-string render tests only.
